newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent makes fresh low, downside target $23.82.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent makes fresh low, downside target $23.82.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 3 Reuter) - IPE Brent futures fell to new lows after pit trading began on the NYMEX on Friday but then made a modest recovery.
February was down 27 cents a barrel at $23.95 at 1510 GMT having hovered just under $24.00 for several hours during the middle of the day. A few minutes earlier the price had dipped to $23.88.
Faltering gas oil futures and bearish American Petroleum Institute (API) stock data were cited as the main reasons for pushing Brent decisively below the psychologically important $24.00 level.

API data showed U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 2.73 million barrels in the week ended December 27 to 295.60 million from 292.87 million, while distillates rose by 2.47 million barrels to 123.80 million from 121.33 million in the previous week.
Traders said the downside targets were at $23.82, the bottom of the gap left by Thursday's rally, and then around $23.50.
In the gas oil market, traders said most activity had centred on the Jan/Feb spread as the front-month's expiry on January 10 drew closer.

The spread stood at $5.75 at Thursday's close but had fallen to $4.50 by mid-afternoon on Friday. Despite a weaker tone, gas oil remained fairly well supported by the cold weather which has chilled Europe since the New Year holiday.
January gas oil was down $4.75 a tonne at $227.25 at 1506 GMT just above $226.75 the days low.
